title: Look, or pick it up?
hook: Would touching an item change your valuation before you own it?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Distinguish physical contact and perceived ownership from legal ownership.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Distinguish physical contact and perceived ownership from legal ownership.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: In this toy ownership ledger, touching a token does not edit its assigned owner. After a touch with no reassignment, how many owner records change? Toy inputs A=[1, 0, 0]; B=[0, 1, 1].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 1]]. Labels: Touched, Reassigned, Owner id.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: A contact action and a change to the assignment ledger are separate events in this toy system. The comparison explicitly reassigns the token. Perceived ownership in a study is not the same measure as the assigned-owner field here.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Touch token=0, Assignment changed=1, Owner id=1. What is Reassigned? Answer: 1.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Touch token=0, Assignment changed=1, Owner id=1. What is Reassigned?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 1. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Just touching an object raises the feeling of ownership and its value (Peck & Shu, 2009).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Distinguish physical contact and perceived ownership from legal ownership.
